releases.notes:
## 1.5.0 - 1.20.1
**Requires Tinkers’ Construct 3.12.1.231+**

### Changed
- Capped experience required for level up at 2147483647.
### Added
- '**NONE**' slot/stat type to enable levels without rewards.
- Separate config settings for shields.
- support for shields stats: **Block Amount** and **Block Angle**.
- Support for 10 modifiers with corresponding settings in server config: **brushing**, **bucketing** (in world placement only), **fishing**, **grappling**, **melting**, **slimeball**, **slurping**, **spilling**, **spitting**, **splashing**.
- Brazilian Portuguese translation (Thanks @Xlr11 ).
- Japanese translation (Thanks @kju8 ).
- Chinese translations for modifier entries in books (Thanks @Niangao-YX ).
- Polish translations for modifier entries in books.
### Fixed
- Game crash when using AoE melee attacks (swipe, circle).
- Game crash when dealing damage with thrown tool.
- Tool gets experience when it hits same player who threw it.
- Exp from AoE attacks is not calculated correctly.
- Translation typos.

## New Contributors
* @kju8 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Pyre540/tinkers-levelling-addon/pull/21
* @Xlr11 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Pyre540/tinkers-levelling-addon/pull/22
* @Niangao-YX made their first contribution in https://github.com/Pyre540/tinkers-levelling-addon/pull/27

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Pyre540/tinkers-levelling-addon/compare/v1.4.3-1.20.1...v1.5.0-1.20.1

releases.notes:
**Requires Tinkers' Construct 3.6.3.113+**
### Changed
- Tools can now gain defence slot. This option is disabled by default. It can be enabled in server config (\*SlotTypeOrder/\*SlotTypeRandomPool).
### Added
- Support for shields and corresponding config settings.
- Modifier textures for [Materialis](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/materialis) and [Tinkers Reforged](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tinkers-reforged) tools.
- Ukrainian translation (Thanks @ItzNyuel).
### Fixed
- Armor gets experience, when all damage is blocked by shield.
- Ranged weapons uses tool's slot configs.

### Changed
- Experience value format is now consistent with tool durability format.
### Fixed
- Game crash when reloading resource pack from main menu (before loading a world).
- Armor slot types random pool default settings is using wrong value set.
- Tool tag in chat message on level up shows tool state before level up.
- Stat values display decimal part when it's not necessary.
- Typos in Polish and English translations.
- Typos in config comments.
